name: SDN Node Activity Flow
description: M2 node-activity flow (mount GET /api/v1/node/activity): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route route_node_activity classifies it (GET/HEAD -> route=activity, limit=<the ?limit query param clamped in-wasm to [1, 256], default 50>; anything else -> route=error status=405 — PATH is not inspected, the mount carries exactly one resource), hostcap/node-activity activity forwards {"limit":N} (the decision's clamped limit, defensively re-clamped to [1, 256] with the same default of 50) to the policy-mediated READ-ONLY node_activity_read.activity hostcall (capability node_activity_read; the host's capPrefixFromName has no mapping for it, so the capability name itself is the op prefix) and emits the raw hostcall result OBJECT verbatim on "body" (a live activity-log snapshot — recent peer connect/disconnect, PNM publication, record-stored, and grant-issued events, newest first, bounded by limit — NOT an SDS record collection, so the bare-array json convention used by the other gateway flows does not apply), and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/405/503) delivered to the host-model egress sink. JSON-ONLY for v1: there is no SDS schema for node activity events (checked spacedatastandards.org/schema — no matching record type), so a flatbuffer presentation is blocked on a future SDS schema addition rather than a hand-written table (generated-types-only rule; fb blocked-on-schema). No ETag/conditional-GET: the activity log changes on every call, so a conditional-GET contract would be pointless. Anonymity: the $HTQ envelope (module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs — METHOD/PATH/QUERY/HEADERS/BODY/REMOTE) carries no caller-trust field a flow can read, so the route is declared anonymous:false (operator-gated at the host's auth wall, mirroring flows/node-status's precedent) until the envelope carries trust information a shape node could read to serve a reduced anonymous subset.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: This node's own recent activity log (wasm; all routing and response shaping run inside the module). Operator-gated (see route anonymous flag) until the $HTQ envelope carries caller-trust information for an anonymous reduced subset.

routes.description: Returns this node's recent activity events as a single JSON object (not a record collection): a count plus a newest-first list of peer_connected/peer_disconnected/pnm_publication/record_stored/grant_issued events. Query parameter ?limit=N bounds the number of events returned; the route node clamps it in-wasm to [1, 256] with a default of 50 (missing, empty, non-numeric, zero, negative, or out-of-range values all fall back to the clamped/default value rather than erroring). Always JSON — there is no SDS schema for node activity events, so no flatbuffer presentation exists (blocked on a future SDS schema addition, not a hand-written table). No ETag/If-None-Match: the activity log changes on every call. Operator-gated (anonymous:false) at the host's auth wall; the flow itself has no access to caller-trust information to shape a reduced anonymous subset.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of activity events to return, newest first. Clamped in-wasm to [1, 256]; defaults to 50 when omitted, empty, non-numeric, zero, negative, or out of range.

count.description: Number of events in this response.

peer_id.description: Omitted when the event carries no peer id.

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON object (not an array): this endpoint answers one activity-log snapshot, not an SDS record collection.

503.description: The node_activity_read.activity hostcall failed or returned no result (honest unavailability — never a silent empty body).
